answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. It survives because finality only counts for established attestators, so a fresh cluster cannot push transactions until it proves honesty across many epochs. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds. Consider a tide as the anchor of the cost.
